CalibrationAcceptIn.description: Calibration inputs plus whether to accept the calibration as metric.
CalibrationAcceptIn.title: CalibrationAcceptIn

CalibrationIn.description:
Calibration inputs.

- ``scan_dpi``: nothing; the scale comes from the source DPI.
- ``scan_segment``: 2 ``control_points`` and ``segment_mm``, their distance on paper.
- ``photo_homography_4pt``: 4 ``control_points`` in order around the quadrilateral;
  each needs ``paper_mm`` unless ``known_dimensions_mm`` is given, which defaults them
  to the corners TL, TR, BR, BL.
- ``none``: nothing.

``check_points`` (each with ``paper_mm``) do not take part in the fit; when present,
``reprojection_error_mm`` is measured on them. ``paper_scale`` (``100`` for 1:100)
applies only to ``scaled_drawing`` plans.
CalibrationIn.title: CalibrationIn

CalibrationMethod.description: Calibration methods; enforced by the ``ck_calibration_method`` check constraint.
CalibrationMethod.title: CalibrationMethod

CalibrationOut.description: The active calibration; ``image_to_paper`` is the 3x3 matrix in mm per pixel.
CalibrationOut.title: CalibrationOut

CalibrationPointOut.description: A stored point: ``role`` ``control`` or ``check``; ``error_mm`` is its residual.
CalibrationPointOut.title: CalibrationPointOut

CalibrationProposalOut.description:
A computed calibration that is not stored.

``image_to_paper`` is the 3x3 matrix (px to paper mm), null for ``none``.
``reprojection_error_basis`` says whether the error is measured on ``check_points`` or
``control_points``; both are null when there is no error to report. ``meets_tolerance``
tells whether ``as_metric`` would be accepted on the error.
CalibrationProposalOut.title: CalibrationProposalOut

CatalogOut.description: The active catalog version with its layers and symbols (SVG inline).
CatalogOut.title: CatalogOut

DimensionGeometry.description:
``declared_value_m`` is null for a plain measurement; ``measured_value_m`` is computed.

A client-sent ``measured_value_m`` is ignored and replaced by the ``p1_m``-``p2_m``
distance; ``declared_value_m`` is kept as sent (``sketch2cad.entities.dimensions``).
DimensionGeometry.title: DimensionGeometry

DimensionsIn.description: Paper size of the rectangle whose corners are the 4 control points.
DimensionsIn.title: DimensionsIn

DxfArc.description: Counter-clockwise arc from ``start_angle`` to ``end_angle``, in degrees.
DxfArc.title: DxfArc

DxfAttributeDefinition.description: ATTDEF filled from the symbol attribute whose upper-cased name is ``tag``.
DxfAttributeDefinition.title: DxfAttributeDefinition

DxfBlock.description: DXF block definition; inserted as ``INSERT`` of ``name`` at the entity anchor.
DxfBlock.title: DxfBlock

EntityIn.description:
A new entity drawn by hand; provenance, review and metric fields are set by the server.

``evidence_id`` places evidence of the plan's case file; only points and symbols may.
EntityIn.title: EntityIn

EntityListOut.description: Entities of a revision, ordered by id; soft-deleted ones are left out.
EntityListOut.title: EntityListOut

EntityOut.description:
An entity of spec section 8.2; ``created_by`` is null for system entities.

``discrepancy`` is set for dimensions only (null for other types): true when
``|declared_value_m - measured_value_m|`` exceeds ``dimension.discrepancy_tolerance_m``.
It is computed on every read and never stored.
EntityOut.title: EntityOut

EntityPatch.description:
An edit. ``geometry`` replaces the whole geometry and keeps the entity's ``kind``.

``move_vertex`` and the ``snap_*`` operations need ``geometry``; ``reclassify`` needs
``layer``; ``relabel`` needs ``geometry``, ``attributes`` or ``evidence_id`` (evidence
of the plan's case file, or ``null`` to drop the reference; only ``relabel`` takes
it, and only for points and symbols). Moving a point or symbol
that has a ``constraint`` needs ``confirm_constraint_removal = true`` (409
``constraint_removal_required`` otherwise); it removes the constraint and sets
``metric_origin`` to ``none`` (spec section 11.3).

The other operations take only their own fields and the server computes the geometry:

- ``fix_length`` (lines and polylines): ``anchor_vertex``, ``value_m`` (> 0, V-04) and
  the optional adjacent ``free_vertex`` (``sketch2cad.entities.ops_fix_length``).
- ``triangulate`` (points and symbols): references ``ref_a`` and ``ref_b`` (each a
  point or symbol id, or a :class:`VertexRef` ``{entity_id, vertex}``), distances
  ``d_a_m`` and ``d_b_m`` (> 0, V-04) and ``solution`` (``nearest``, the default, is
  the candidate closest to the current position; ``alt`` is the other one).
- ``baseline_offset`` (points and symbols): base points ``base_a`` and ``base_b``
  (references as in ``triangulate``; two vertices of the same entity are allowed),
  ``s_m`` along A→B (any sign), perpendicular ``d_m`` (>= 0) and ``side``.
EntityPatch.title: EntityPatch

EntityPatchOut.description:
The edited entity; ``triangulate`` also returns its candidate positions.

``candidates`` holds the 1 (tangent circles) or 2 intersection points, the first to the
left of the direction from ``ref_a`` to ``ref_b``; ``chosen_candidate`` is the index of
the one applied. Both are null for every other operation.
EntityPatchOut.title: EntityPatchOut

EntitySource.description: Provenance of an entity; kept unchanged by edits (history lives in the events).
EntitySource.title: EntitySource

EntityType.description: Entity types; enforced by the ``ck_entity_type`` check constraint.
EntityType.title: EntityType

EventKind.description: Minimum event kinds of spec section 14.1, plus ``revision.reopened`` (section 9.2).
EventKind.title: EventKind

EventOut.description: One event exactly as hashed; ``occurred_at`` is UTC ISO 8601 with microseconds.
EventOut.title: EventOut

EventPage.description: Up to 50 events in ascending id; ``next_cursor`` is null on the last page.
EventPage.title: EventPage

EvidenceCreate.description: New evidence; ``attributes`` values are JSON primitives, like entity attributes.
EvidenceCreate.title: EvidenceCreate

EvidenceListOut.description: Evidence of a case file ordered by number.
EvidenceListOut.title: EvidenceListOut

EvidencePatch.description: An edit of ``label`` and/or ``attributes`` (replaced whole); ``number`` is immutable.
EvidencePatch.title: EvidencePatch

IncidentType.description: Kind of incident; stored as the PostgreSQL enum ``incident_type``.
IncidentType.title: IncidentType

JobErrorOut.description: Why the job failed and what to do, in Spanish (REQ-15).
JobErrorOut.title: JobErrorOut

Layer.description: One CAD layer with its DXF color as an AutoCAD Color Index (1-255).
Layer.title: Layer

LeaseOut.description:
The valid edit lease of a plan: who holds it and until when.

``display_name`` is the holder's display name, or their username when none is set.
LeaseOut.title: LeaseOut

LeaseReleaseOut.description: Outcome of a release: ``released`` is false when the caller held no lease.
LeaseReleaseOut.title: LeaseReleaseOut

LocalFrameIn.description:
The local frame: origin on paper (mm, Y down), +X axis and North angles in degrees.

Angles are counter-clockwise positive: ``x_axis_angle_deg`` from the world +X axis,
``north_angle_deg`` from the local +Y axis. They are stored reduced to ``[0, 360)``.
LocalFrameIn.title: LocalFrameIn

MetricOrigin.description: Where the metric value of an entity comes from; enforced by ``ck_entity_metric_origin``.
MetricOrigin.title: MetricOrigin

MetricStatus.description: Metric quality of a plan; stored as the PostgreSQL enum ``metric_status``.
MetricStatus.title: MetricStatus

MetricStatusOut.description:
Metric status of a plan and what keeps it from ``metric`` (spec section 11.3).

``blocking_entities`` are the ids of the live entities of the current revision in
``L_STRUCTURE`` or ``L_ACCESS``, or referencing an evidence item, whose
``metric_origin`` is not metric; ``reasons`` maps each of them to its reason code (that
``metric_origin``: ``trace_only`` or ``none``). A plan without an accepted calibration is
``non_metric`` with no blocking entity. ``discrepant_dimensions`` lists the dimensions
whose declared and measured values disagree; they do not change ``status``.
MetricStatusOut.title: MetricStatusOut

PlanOut.description:
A plan with its active calibration, edit lease and current revision.

``calibration`` is null until a calibration is accepted. ``lease`` is null while no
user holds a valid (unexpired) edit lease.
PlanOut.title: PlanOut

PlanStatus.description: The nine plan states of spec section 9.2; stored as the PostgreSQL enum ``plan_status``.
PlanStatus.title: PlanStatus

PointIn.description: A marked point: image pixel and, when known, its paper position in mm (Y down).
PointIn.title: PointIn

PolylineGeometry.description: Open polyline of at least 2 vertices; a closed one needs at least 3.
PolylineGeometry.title: PolylineGeometry

ReviewStatus.description: Review state of an entity; enforced by ``ck_entity_review_status``.
ReviewStatus.title: ReviewStatus

ScaleOut.description: Scan scale; ``within_tolerance`` compares the segment with the DPI when both exist.
ScaleOut.title: ScaleOut

SourceMode.description: How the source was drawn; stored as the PostgreSQL enum ``source_mode``.
SourceMode.title: SourceMode

Symbol.description: One symbol of spec 12.2; ``default_size`` is in mm (``paper_mm``) or m (``world_m``).
Symbol.title: Symbol

SymbolGeometry.description: A catalog symbol; ``attributes`` holds its block attributes (e.g. ``evidence_number``).
SymbolGeometry.title: SymbolGeometry

TransitionIn.description: Requested target status; ``reason`` is required for ``REJECTED``, optional otherwise.
TransitionIn.title: TransitionIn

UserRole.description: Role of a user; stored as the PostgreSQL enum ``user_role``.
UserRole.title: UserRole

VertexRef.description:
A vertex of a ``line`` or ``polyline`` used as a metric reference (a wall corner).

PoC assumption (2026-10-26, D-15, to revisit with real sketches): ``triangulate`` and
``baseline_offset`` may take a vertex of a wall whose lengths are declared (or that is
on a metric scaled drawing) as a reference, not only a point or symbol entity.
VertexRef.title: VertexRef

post.description:
Check the credentials and open a session; failures never reveal whether a user exists.

A locked account gets 423 even with the right password; the password is still verified
first so the response time does not reveal whether it was correct.
Revoke the current session and clear both authentication cookies.

get.description:
List the case files the user created or is a member of, newest first.

``limit`` above the maximum is capped rather than rejected.

post.description: Create a case file with the next ``EXP-<year>-<NNNN>`` code; the creator becomes member.

get.description:
Return a case file; 404 when it is missing or malformed.

A user without ``read`` (member or not) gets 403; every denial on an existing case file
is logged as ``access.denied``.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the case file (access.denied).

404.description: The case file does not exist.

get.description: Evidence register of the case file, ordered by number. Requires ``read``.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the case file (access.denied).

404.description: The case file does not exist.

post.description:
Register evidence with the next number of the case file and ``evidence.created``.

Requires ``edit``.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the case file (access.denied).

404.description: The case file does not exist.

post.description:
Add a member with explicit permissions; only an ``admin`` or the creator may do it.

Anyone else gets 403, logged as ``access.denied``; an unknown
``user_id`` gives 422 and an existing member 409.

Create a plan from a source of the case file, in ``CALIBRATION_PENDING``.

``source_mode`` defaults to ``schematic_sketch``. Creates revision 1 in ``draft`` and a
``plan.created`` event; enqueues no job. Requires ``edit``.

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the case file (access.denied).

404.description: The case file does not exist.

422.description: Invalid body, or the primary source is not a source of the case.

post.description:
Ingest one source file (multipart fields ``file`` and ``client_sha256``).

The size cap is enforced while the body streams in (413). The server SHA-256 must equal
``client_sha256`` (422) and the content must be a JPEG, PNG, TIFF or single-page PDF by
its bytes (415); nothing is stored when a rule fails. Requires ``edit``.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG, TIFF or single-page PDF by content (V-01).

422.description: Malformed upload, or client_sha256 differs from the server (V-03).

get.description: Return the active catalog; requires a session but no case permission.

delete.description:
Soft-delete the entity (sets ``deleted_at``; the row stays) with ``entity.deleted``.

``reason`` is optional. Requires ``edit``.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the plan's case file (access.denied).

404.description: The revision or entity does not exist, or the entity is deleted.

409.description: The revision is frozen, the plan is not in EDITING or IN_REVIEW (``code`` ``V-10`` when validated), or the user does not hold the plan's edit lease (``code`` ``V-12`` with ``holder``, or ``lease_required``).

422.description: Invalid body, a layer or symbol not in the active catalog, an ``evidence_id`` that is not evidence of the plan's case file (or set on an entity that is not a point or symbol), or a ``fix_length``, ``triangulate`` or ``baseline_offset`` that cannot be applied: ``code`` ``V-04`` for a distance <= 0, ``V-06`` when the two distances do not cross, ``V-07`` when a reference is not metric or depends on the entity. Nothing changes.

patch.description:
Edit geometry, attributes or layer with an ``operation``; ``source`` is preserved.

Appends ``entity.updated`` with ``before``, ``after`` (plus ``operation``) and the
optional ``reason``. ``triangulate`` and ``baseline_offset`` store the ``constraint``
and set ``metric_origin``; ``triangulate`` also returns ``candidates``. Requires
``edit``.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the plan's case file (access.denied).

404.description: The revision or entity does not exist, or the entity is deleted.

409.description: The revision is frozen, the plan is not in EDITING or IN_REVIEW (``code`` ``V-10`` when validated), or the user does not hold the plan's edit lease (``code`` ``V-12`` with ``holder``, or ``lease_required``).

422.description: Invalid body, a layer or symbol not in the active catalog, an ``evidence_id`` that is not evidence of the plan's case file (or set on an entity that is not a point or symbol), or a ``fix_length``, ``triangulate`` or ``baseline_offset`` that cannot be applied: ``code`` ``V-04`` for a distance <= 0, ``V-06`` when the two distances do not cross, ``V-07`` when a reference is not metric or depends on the entity. Nothing changes.

patch.description:
Change the label and/or attributes with ``evidence.updated``; the number stays.

Requires ``edit`` on the evidence's case file.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the case file (access.denied).

get.description:
Status of a job; ``error {cause, action}`` is present only when it failed.

Requires ``read`` on the case file of the job's source.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the job's case file (access.denied).

get.description:
A plan with its status, active calibration, lease and current revision.

Requires ``read`` on the plan's case file; others get 403 and an ``access.denied``
event.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

put.description:
Compute the matrix, the reprojection error and ``meets_tolerance``; store nothing.

Requires ``edit``. 409 when the plan is past ``EDITING`` or has entities (V-08).

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

409.description: The plan is past editing, or it has entities (``code`` ``V-08``).

422.description: Invalid body, or inputs that define no calibration for the method.

post.description:
Store the calibration as the plan's active one and move the plan to ``EDITING``.

Appends ``calibration.proposed`` and ``calibration.accepted``. ``as_metric`` is
rejected for ``none`` and above the reprojection tolerance (V-05). Method ``none``
leaves the plan ``non_metric``. Requires ``edit`` and the plan's edit lease.

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

409.description: The plan is past editing, it has entities (``code`` ``V-08``), or the user does not hold its edit lease (``code`` ``V-12`` with ``holder``, or ``lease_required``).

422.description: Invalid inputs, or ``as_metric`` not allowed: method ``none``, a ``scaled_drawing`` without ``paper_scale``, or an error above ``calibration.max_reprojection_error_mm`` (``code`` ``V-05``).

delete.description:
Release the caller's edit lease with ``lease.released``. Requires ``edit``.

Only the holder releases. ``released`` is false, and nothing is written, when the
caller holds no lease; 409 with ``holder`` while another user holds a valid one.

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

409.description: Another user holds a valid lease: ``code`` ``V-12``, ``holder`` and the V-12 message.

post.description:
Acquire or renew the plan's edit lease for 10 minutes. Requires ``edit``.

A renewal by the holder writes no event; a first acquisition, or one after the lease
expired, writes ``lease.acquired`` (``before`` is the previous lease). 409 with
``holder`` and the V-12 message while another user holds a valid lease.

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

409.description: Another user holds a valid lease: ``code`` ``V-12``, ``holder`` and the V-12 message.

put.description:
Set the plan's local frame on its active calibration. Requires ``edit``.

A change of origin or +X axis moves every live entity of the draft revision by one
rigid transform in one transaction. The first frame writes ``local_frame.set``; later
changes write one ``local_frame.changed`` with the previous and new frame and the
transform (null when only the North changes). An unchanged frame writes nothing.

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

409.description: The plan has no accepted calibration, its revision is frozen, it is not in EDITING or IN_REVIEW (``code`` ``V-10`` when validated), or the user does not hold its edit lease (``code`` ``V-12`` with ``holder``, or ``lease_required``).

get.description:
Metric status of the plan and the entities that keep it from ``metric``.

Computed from the active calibration and the live entities of the current revision
with the same rule that keeps ``plan.metric_status`` up to date on every change, so
``status`` equals that field. Writes nothing. Requires ``read`` on the plan's case
file; others get 403 and an ``access.denied`` event.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the plan's case file (access.denied).

post.description:
Move the plan to ``to`` following the spec section 9.2 table. Requires ``edit``.

``REVIEW_PENDING`` (technician or reviewer) releases the caller's lease;
``IN_REVIEW`` (reviewer) takes it; ``VALIDATED`` (reviewer) freezes the current
revision and sets ``validated_revision_id``; ``REJECTED`` (reviewer, ``reason``
required) and ``REOPENED`` (reviewer, from ``VALIDATED`` or ``EXPORTED``, creating
draft revision ``n + 1``) continue to ``EDITING``. Each step writes ``plan.transition``.

403.description: The user lacks ``edit`` on the plan's case file, or their role may not perform the transition (``code`` ``V-09`` and its message for ``VALIDATED``); both write access.denied.

409.description: The pair is not in the spec section 9.2 table (``code`` ``illegal_transition``) or is performed by the system (``system_transition``), both with ``allowed``; another user holds the edit lease (``V-12`` with ``holder``); or the revision cannot be frozen or reopened (``revision_conflict``).

422.description: Invalid body, or a rejection without reason (``code`` ``V-09``).

get.description: Entities of the revision ordered by id, without soft-deleted ones. Requires ``read``.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the plan's case file (access.denied).

post.description:
Create one or more hand-drawn entities, in request order, with ``entity.created`` each.

The server sets ``source`` (``manual``), ``review_status`` (``accepted``) and
``metric_origin``. Requires ``edit``; 409 unless the revision is an editable draft.

403.description: The user lacks the permission on the plan's case file (access.denied).

404.description: The revision or entity does not exist, or the entity is deleted.

409.description: The revision is frozen, the plan is not in EDITING or IN_REVIEW (``code`` ``V-10`` when validated), or the user does not hold the plan's edit lease (``code`` ``V-12`` with ``holder``, or ``lease_required``).

422.description: Invalid body, a layer or symbol not in the active catalog, an ``evidence_id`` that is not evidence of the plan's case file (or set on an entity that is not a point or symbol), or a ``fix_length``, ``triangulate`` or ``baseline_offset`` that cannot be applied: ``code`` ``V-04`` for a distance <= 0, ``V-06`` when the two distances do not cross, ``V-07`` when a reference is not metric or depends on the entity. Nothing changes.

get.description:
Metadata of a source, including ``qc`` once its quality job has finished.

``qc`` is null while the job is queued or running. Requires ``read``; others get 403
and an ``access.denied`` event.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the source's case file (access.denied).

get.description:
Stream the original bytes exactly as stored, with ``X-Content-SHA256``.

Writes ``source.downloaded`` before the first byte is sent. Requires ``read``; others
get 403 and an ``access.denied`` event.

200.description: The original bytes, unmodified, as an attachment.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the source's case file (access.denied).

get.description:
Derived JPEG of the source whose longest side is at most ``max`` (256 to 4096).

PDFs are rendered from page 1; no EXIF is carried over. Requires ``read``.

200.description: Derived JPEG whose longest side is at most ``max`` pixels.

403.description: The user lacks ``read`` on the source's case file (access.denied).

get.description: Return 200 when the database answers ``SELECT 1`` and 503 otherwise.
